research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Aurora Solar is engaged in developing systems for constructing three-dimensional representations of roof structures, as described in '3d building modeling system.' Their work includes methods for automated three-dimensional building model estimation, which predict rooftop outlines, pitches, and heights using aerial imagery and 3D data. These areas of research and development focus on leveraging aerial imagery and modeling techniques to assess and represent complex roof structures for solar installation projects.

about_short_description.short_description: Aurora Solar is a SaaS company that uses aerial imagery to assess solar installation projects.

product.name: Aurora Platform
product.description: A cloud-based solar and storage software platform for selling, designing, financing, and delivering residential PV projects using aerial imagery, 3D modeling, proposals, and project workflows.

product.name: Aurora AI
product.description: AI-powered tools that generate 3D roof models and solar system designs from an address and utility-bill information, helping solar teams prepare proposals remotely.

product.name: HelioScope
product.description: A solar design and modeling software product for commercial and other larger PV projects, supporting system layout, performance analysis, and project planning.

product.name: Expert Design Services
product.description: A professional solar design service in which Aurora specialists prepare system designs for installers and solar companies that need additional design capacity.

product.name: Plan Sets
product.description: An on-demand service for producing solar permitting plan sets to support post-sale permitting and submission to authorities having jurisdiction.

product.name: Solar for Homeowners
product.description: A homeowner-facing solar quoting experience that provides personalized estimates and visualizations for evaluating a potential residential solar installation.
